title: Expedited: Patch ION DAO Accounting and Quarantine Legacy Claims
summary: Atomically migrate the adminless ION DAO contract to reviewed v0.0.2 before proposals 22-39 can enter their ordinary legacy-deposit claim path. The patch fixes future proposal-deposit accounting and quarantines pre-migration claims pending separate reconciliation. It does not reconstruct historical payers or distribute treasury funds.
details:
The live ION DAO contract at osmo1k8re7jwz6rnnwrktnejdwkwnncte7ek7gt29gvnl3sdrg9mtnqkse6nmqm reports code ID 3, no admin, and CW2 crates.io:ion-dao 0.0.1. An ordinary ION DAO WasmMsg::Migrate cannot pass wasmd authorization because the contract has no stored admin. The required route is Osmosis x/gov executing /cosmwasm.wasm.v1.MsgStoreAndMigrateContract under governance authority osmo10d07y265gmmuvt4z0w9aw880jnsr700jjeq4qp.

At the 2026-07-11 19:27:02 UTC snapshot, proposals 22-39 were all open and unclaimable. They recorded 662 ION of deposits although normal retained base across 18 proposals was 9 ION, creating apparent excess claim exposure of 653 ION. Their voting windows end from 2026-07-17 11:09:01 through 11:30:35 UTC. Ordinary rejection/failed quorum can be closed into a refundable state; only a successful veto path confiscates.

The v0.0.2 migration requires exact CW2 source/version, records an inclusive migration cutoff, blocks pre-cutoff claims before mutation or bank send, rejects fresh same-block proposal/top-up traps, and fixes net retained accounting for future proposals. It does not infer who should receive historical funds.

The production proposal artifact is 447,489 bytes with SHA-256 37bb98453ddf9495c2cdf9a2667d515164ef9e09b15385921eaba9270d148f3e. The deterministic osmosisd gzip payload is 150,198 bytes with SHA-256 37e6e3ff0eddfc9b4bb162ffd241d39d3d204f1cfa76cfef7510bd4fe1c099f5. Reviewed source head is 81736b1bcfebdd1e3239ae37f18cef24f32d9272. Validation passed 80 DAO tests, 8 stake tests, Rust 1.64 formatting and strict Clippy, schema and TypeScript regeneration/build, repeated byte-identical Wasm builds, optimizer reproducibility, and independent exact-head review.

A bounded Juno mainnet proof migrated a self-admin proof DAO from code 5142 to 5143, set cutoff height 39710117, rejected a simulated legacy claim with 'Deposit claim requires manual reconciliation', and preserved a normal post-migration one-time claim. This proves migration/state behavior; native Osmosis governance authority is separately established by the exact message, keeper authority, and Osmosis proposals 853 and 896 using the same message type.

Expedited governance is recommended because the safe standard five-day start cutoff is 2026-07-12 05:09:01 UTC. Expedited voting lasts 24 hours, requires a full 20,000 OSMO deposit to start, and requires more than 66.7% Yes among non-abstaining votes. The minimum 5,000 OSMO initial deposit only enters deposit period and does not start voting. If an expedited vote misses its higher threshold, Cosmos SDK v0.50 converts it to the regular five-day timeline; after the standard cutoff that fallback would finish too late, so the expedited round itself must pass.

Full rationale, exact payload, risks, vote guidance, source links, and proof receipts are published in the public proposal package and discussion PR.
vote_option_context: YES: execute the reviewed atomic in-place patch and quarantine legacy claims. NO: leave the contract unchanged while seeking another implementation; this does not itself contain the approaching claim path. NO WITH VETO: reserve for abuse/spam; current Osmosis parameters burn deposits on a final veto outcome. ABSTAIN: count toward quorum without choosing Yes or No.
